editorial:
Imagine being trapped on a plane while a hidden killer texts you threats every few minutes. That is the tense setup here, and it pulls you in fast. Liam Neeson plays Bill Marks, a tired air marshal who must find the person sending messages before passengers start dying. The movie keeps you guessing because almost everyone on the flight looks suspicious, and the tight airplane setting makes every clue feel urgent. It is not deep, but it is a fun ride with steady suspense and a few clever twists.

The action is solid, the pacing rarely slows, and Neeson brings his usual tough-guy energy. Some plot turns are a little silly, and the villain motive may not satisfy everyone. Still, if you enjoy locked-room thrillers and want an easy, exciting watch, this delivers. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Bill discovers the threats are part of a plan to make him look like the hijacker. The real killers are on the plane and want to crash it for a payout and revenge. Bill fights them, stops the bomb, and lands the plane safely. The passengers finally trust him, and the true villains are exposed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves locked-room thrillers and Liam Neeson action movies.
